WatchedMovie.title: WatchedMovie
WatchedMovie.description: A movie or TV series marked as watched by an authenticated user, including TMDB metadata, watch timestamp, optional season progress, and personal rating/note.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this watched entry.

movieId.description: TMDB numeric movie or TV show ID.

title.description: Movie title or TV series name.

releaseDate.description: Movie release date or TV first air date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

userRating.description: User's personal 1-5 star rating (0 when unrated).

note.description: User's personal watch note or short review.

overview.description: Movie or TV series synopsis from TMDB.

genres.description: List of up to 10 genre names.

runtime.description: Movie runtime or average TV episode runtime in minutes.

numberOfSeasons.description: Total number of seasons for TV series (0 for movies).

numberOfEpisodes.description: Total number of episodes for TV series (0 for movies).

watchedSeason.description: Specific season watched by the user (0 = full show / unspecified, 1+ = specific season).

watchedAt.description: Server timestamp when marked as watched (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/watched/{watchedId}.description: Per-user subcollection of watched movies and TV shows keyed by movieId (for movies) or tv_{id} (for TV shows).
